locator.title: 35+: ваше золотое время, чтобы сохранить молодость
locator.lead: Что происходит с яичниками после 35 и как продлить их (и свою) молодость

nearest_text_before.text: Он не умирает. Он просто «засыпает». Фолликулы есть, но они не растут. Гормоны не вырабатываются. И вы начинаете чувствовать все эти изменения.

nearest_text_after.text: Как проверить, что происходит с яичниками?

inputs.user_direction: Plan a canonical first-frame-only, non-loop five-second preservation repair. Confine each tiny continuous trajectory to its original icon region: one ovarian pulse; only the purple aura contracts and dims around the fixed molecule and bonds; balance one shallow sway; needle turns inside dial; drops fall inside their region; irritation lines meander smoothly. Mandatory battery motion: interior fills red through yellow to full green and stays green. Preserve text, arrows, masks and layout. positive_prompt at most 480 characters. Include a concise negative_prompt against observed jerking, morphing, mask leakage and layout drift.

image_reading: A static Russian-language medical infographic links ovaries to decreased progesterone, estrogen dominance, and four symptom icons: weight, edema, irritability, and fatigue.
The composition uses fixed labels, arrows, a molecular diagram with a purple aura, scales, a dial, water drops, a distressed profile, and a low red battery.
analysis.article_context: Body infographic following the explanation that reduced ovarian activity lowers progesterone and contributes to weight changes, edema, irritability, and fatigue; the animation should reinforce this causal relationship while preserving the diagram’s informational structure.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: Reduced ovarian hormone activity is presented as a connected cause of several physical and emotional symptoms, with restored energy as the emphasized endpoint.
structured_intent.primary_action: The infographic’s linked physiological indicators activate locally while the energy indicator progressively replenishes.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The battery is visibly full green while every other element remains within its original labeled region and the diagram stays intact.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The causal diagram, its Russian labels, arrows, molecular structure, icon identities, and spatial relationships retain their original meaning throughout.

models.scene_plan: Keep the camera fixed for the full five seconds. Begin all restrained in-region trajectories promptly and let them develop smoothly: a single ovarian pulse, contracting and dimming purple aura around an immobile molecule, one shallow balance sway, a small needle turn, local falling drops, and gently meandering irritation lines. The battery fill is the dominant continuous progression, advancing from red through yellow to green near the end and remaining fully green in the final frame. All labels, arrows, masks, molecular bonds, icon boundaries, and layout remain fixed.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera. Over five seconds, animate only tiny smooth motions inside each icon region: one ovarian pulse; the purple aura contracts and dims around the fixed molecule and bonds; scales make one shallow sway; the dial needle turns slightly; drops fall locally; irritation lines meander smoothly. The battery interior steadily fills red through yellow to full green, ending and staying fully green. Preserve all text, arrows, masks, and layout.
models.negative_prompt: No jerking, flicker, morphing, warped icons or text, mask leakage, region spill, broken bonds, altered arrows, or layout drift.
